still_measuring.title: Words dictated with Wispr Flow while building this
still_measuring.why: Only Wispr's own Insights can show this. The app can read your local Wispr history, but a self-computed count is not the verified one, so the builder supplies the Insights card.

still_measuring.title: A real coding-agent answer through FlowMesh
still_measuring.why: The agent plumbing is tested against mock CLIs and a real Codex run started and finished, but Codex's own Windows sandbox failed to read the test file on the build machine, so no real answer has come through yet.

still_measuring.title: Relays and councils with real models
still_measuring.why: Tested end to end against scripted and mock agents in both runtimes; never run with real models, so how useful the votes and scores are is unmeasured.

still_measuring.title: MCP servers against real services
still_measuring.why: The protocol client is tested against a mock server. Discord, Slack, Notion and Switch are templates that were never run against a real workspace.

still_measuring.title: Wispr key press into the capture field, and the wake word hearing a real voice
still_measuring.why: The harness and the recogniser are tested with typed events and a fake recogniser; nobody has spoken to either on record.

still_measuring.title: Wispr account sign-in after the person approves
still_measuring.why: Discovery, registration and the redirect to Wispr's real login page were checked against Wispr's live servers; the token exchange after sign-in was not re-verified.

still_measuring.title: Windows system-volume keys and real tab capture
still_measuring.why: Tested with injected fakes; the automation environment blocks tab capture and no real volume change was observed.

still_measuring.title: Plan quality against human judgement
still_measuring.why: There is no labelled corpus of dictated commands with correct plans. The eval measures routing, parity and safety invariants, not whether a plan matches intent.

still_measuring.title: Time saved
still_measuring.why: No measurement exists, so none is claimed anywhere.
